name: instagram-platform
description: Manage Instagram Business/Creator accounts via Meta Graph API (profile, media, comments, insights).

META_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Meta access token
META_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Facebook User access token for Instagram Graph API with Facebook Login. Required. Do not commit this value.

IG_USER_ID.title: Instagram professional account ID
IG_USER_ID.description: IG User ID of the Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page. Required.
